replies.text: I have known SO MANY cis girls and women with Mariner-style, friendly, brash, boisterous, dominant, fun-loving personalities. Maybe not to actual cartoon levels of intensity, but close! I've know such people in school and then college, and from church due to my fundie upbringing, and from my current social circles.
replies.author: Phen

replies.text: In my opinion, people focus overly much on gender differences in the interpersonal circumplex (dominance, warmth, agreeableness, assertiveness, etc.) compared to other areas that tend to be bigger. I wonder if maybe it's because it's something that both essentialists and feminists like to talk about (albeit for different reasons - with feminists tending to consider it rooted in socialization and a contributor to patriarchy). However, aspects like interests to tend be bigger, and IIRC Mariner is also quite masculine there.
replies.author: tailcalled
